glosses: aus mehreren kleineren, strahlenförmig angeordneten (am Ende des Blattstiels sitzenden) Blättchen bestehend
Having three or more lobes or veins arising from a common point.

examples.text: Although palmate leaves are typical of most Western maples, a number of species have leaves without lobes.

glosses: Having more than three leaflets arising from a common point, often in the form of a fan.

examples.text: The horse chestnut, buckeye and hickory trees have palmate leaves. That is, the broad oval leaflets are all set around the tip of a common leaf stem, spreading in a circle, like the ribs of a palm leaf fan.
The Palmate Newt is a common Western European amphibian.

glosses: Hand-like; shaped like a hand with extended fingers
Any salt or ester of ricinoleic acid (formerly called palmic acid); a ricinoleate.
